description: Calculate a turn-by-turn route between 2–10 waypoints. Supported costing: auto, bicycle, pedestrian, truck, motor_scooter, and bus. Returns GeoJSON, distance, duration, and maneuvers. Set elevation to true for a terrain profile with gain and loss. Requires a subscription key.

costing.description: Travel mode used to weight the road graph.

elevation.description: Sample a terrain profile along the route and report total gain and loss in metres.

locations.description: Ordered waypoints, 2 to 10; first is the origin and last is the destination.

name: route
